boundedChecks: Denied Photos export is reported separately from five private originals; the actual exporter keeps all five IDs and makes no permission prompt or native SDK write when permission is already denied. Native SDK is mocked.
All-uncertain Photos results display a check-Photos notice and omit the no-op guest export retry.
Denied camera permission grants through a synthetic request; blocked permission invokes only the explicit mocked settings marker.

boundedChecks.check: Reduced-motion digits remain at scale/opacity1; synthetic background interruption cancels the sequence before exposure and returns paused on foreground.

boundedChecks: Synthetic private-save failure shows retry; retry saves the same exposure without a second camera-adapter call. Native journal/filesystem guarantees are not verified.

Host controls, local-session library and private setup render through synthetic authentication; the pairing field stays blank and no provisioning request is made. Host ScrollViews may require vertical scrolling.

hostChecks.check: Uncertain export requires explicit duplicate-risk confirmation; cancel performs no native SDK write; confirm exports exactly the selected original.
Already in Photos requires host confirmation, cancel leaves uncertainty, and confirmed acknowledgment changes one status without making a native SDK copy.
A retained earlier take can be viewed/exported individually; it changes no guest selection and receives no guest upload job.
Staged exposure is not counted as saved, is not offered to Photos, and becomes one saved selected original only after Finish local save.
